title: Prompt Engineering That Holds Up in Production
description: Move past clever one-off prompts into prompts that behave consistently at scale.
learningOutcomes: Design system prompts that constrain behavior reliably
Get structured, parseable output from a model

lessons.title: System Prompts and Roles
lessons.description: What the system/user/assistant roles actually do to model behavior.
learningObjectives: Write a system prompt that constrains scope
Avoid prompt injection from user content

lessons.title: Few-shot Examples
lessons.description: Show the model the shape of a good answer instead of describing it.
learningObjectives: Add few-shot examples to a prompt
Choose examples that cover edge cases
Know when few-shot is worth the extra tokens

lessons.title: Structured and JSON Output
lessons.description: Get output your code can parse instead of prose you have to guess at.
learningObjectives: Use a Pydantic model as the output contract

lessons.title: Testing and Iterating on Prompts
lessons.description: Treat a prompt like code: version it, test it, and catch regressions.
learningObjectives: Build a small prompt regression test set

assignment.title: Assignment: A Prompt Regression Test Harness
assignment.description: Build a real tool that scores two prompt versions against a shared eval set and flags regressions between them — every technique in this module working together.
learningObjectives: Build a reusable eval harness that scores a prompt against a schema-validated task
Compare two prompt versions on the same data and detect per-case regressions
Combine system prompts, few-shot examples, and structured output into one working tool
